transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?
My mind keeps jumping to every little thing around me, and I can’t stay focused on what I’m supposed to be doing anymore. It's gotten so bad that I'm having a really hard time keeping up with my job.
Have you struggled with these focus and attention problems since childhood, or is this a more recent change in your life?

No, this is definitely a recent change and not something from my childhood. It all started ramping up about seven months ago when I transitioned from long-haul driving to a regional freight sales job. Since then, these issues with my focus and energy have been causing real trouble.
When your mind is jumping from thing to thing, do you find yourself constantly worrying about various everyday matters, like your work performance, finances, or family?

No, it's not really worry or anxiety that's distracting me, because I actually feel pretty confident about my work and all my big plans. It's more that my mind gets pulled away by external things like a bird outside or phone notifications, or just a rush of exciting new ideas that pop into my head. I feel like I could easily handle it all if my brain would just stop jumping from one thing to the next.
Have you ever experienced periods in the past where you felt the exact opposite—such as feeling very down, sad, or losing interest in almost everything for at least two weeks?

No, I haven't really experienced periods of feeling very down, sad, or losing interest like that. My main struggles have mostly just been some anxiety in the past, and then this recent high-energy distractibility where my mind is constantly racing.
Is this the very first time in your life you've experienced a period of high energy and racing thoughts like this, or have you had similar phases in the past?

I'm not quite sure, but I don't think I've ever experienced phases this intense in the past. I've had some anxiety before, but these specific feelings of high energy and racing thoughts really only became a major issue over the last seven months since I switched jobs.
You mentioned having a hard time keeping up with your job. Has this high energy or distractibility caused severe disruptions, like major trouble at work or serious conflicts with people close to you?

Yes, it has caused major disruptions at both work and home. I nearly lost a key account because of my poor follow-through, and my boss has warned me about my erratic hours and overpromising. On top of that, my wife is furious and worried because I'm missing family events and running up credit card debt on gear for projects I never finish.

Even if they weren't as intense as what you're experiencing now, have you ever had any past periods lasting at least a few days where you felt unusually energized, active, or needed much less sleep than normal?

No, I haven't really experienced periods like that before my job transition seven months ago. These intense feelings of high energy, needing less sleep, and constantly being on the go only started becoming noticeable after I made the switch to the regional sales role.
Around the time these symptoms started seven months ago, did you start taking any new medications, supplements, or other substances?
No, I didn't start taking any new medications, supplements, or other substances around that time. Everything was pretty much the same on that front when all of this started.
During this period of high energy, have you heard or seen things that others couldn't, or felt you had special, extraordinary abilities that others found highly unusual?

No, I’ve never heard or seen things that aren't there. But I do feel exceptionally capable, like I'm the only person at my company who actually knows how to turn this sales region around and could easily double our sales while running my own side businesses at the same time.
Have you felt that you are receiving special, hidden messages from the TV or internet, or that people are actively watching, spying on, or plotting against you?
No, I’ve never felt that way. I don’t get any hidden messages from the TV or anything, and I definitely don’t feel like anyone is spying on me or plotting against me.
Have you ever felt you have special powers, like being able to read minds, control things with your thoughts, or having a unique connection to a higher power?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I've never felt like I had those kinds of supernatural powers or any special connection like that.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a first-time, distinct period of abnormally elevated energy, activity, and mood starting 7 months ago, which has caused severe functional impairment at work and home. Symptoms include marked distractibility, racing thoughts, inflated self-esteem (grandiosity regarding sales capabilities and side businesses), decreased need for sleep, and reckless behavior (impulsive spending and running up credit card debt). There is no history of major depressive episodes, and psychotic symptoms (hallucinations or delusions) are absent, meeting the criteria for a manic episode without psychotic symptoms (F30.1).
